options.text: The individual records, because the frequency table keeps category totals but not which student chose which subject.
The frequency table alone, because the table is already the list of individual student choices.
Only the frequency table, even though she must match each student to one subject.
A decorated chart title, because neat artwork is required for person-subject matching.

stem:
Sonia has a frequency table that shows how many students chose each subject for the club period. She now wants to pair each student with the subject that student chose.

What does she need?

teacher.key_rationale: A frequency table keeps how many chose each subject but drops which student chose which subject, so pairing needs the individual records.
